name: 月間カレンダー
prompt:
Create one exact 390×588 portrait calendar component crop. Reference 1 is the original Google Calendar crop and controls the seven-column, six-week geometry, Sunday-first date sequence, selected date, and event positions. Reference 2 is the approved Japanese mock and controls the Japanese month heading, weekday labels, event copy, event stacking, and compact layout. Use the mock for content and layout only where it agrees with the original and current Lighthouse design guidance for colors and surfaces.

Preserve the mock’s clear text hierarchy: 「2021年5月」 is the prominent bold heading; month arrows are small supporting controls; weekday labels are smaller and muted; date numerals are compact and regular; event tags use the smallest text. Keep consistent vertical rhythm so the heading, weekday row, dates, and tags do not collide. The surface and outer canvas are flat pure white #FFFFFF, with fine light-neutral grid lines, near-black #1D1D1D heading and in-month dates, muted gray weekday and out-of-month labels, and slate #526173 month arrows. Do not add mint panels, green wash, texture, glow, or decorative utility icons.

Under the heading, use exactly 「日 月 火 水 木 金 土」 and six rows of seven dates, beginning Apr 25–May 1 and ending May 30–Jun 5. Reproduce only the Japanese event labels shown in the mock, on the same dates with the same stacking; do not invent or omit event tags. Use one consistent forest-green event-tag style with small, legible white text, matching the mock’s compact tags. The original screen visibly selects May 25 with a blue circle; preserve this source-established selected state, with white date text inside the blue circle. Blue is reserved for that selected date.

The component contains only the month heading, two month arrows, weekday row, and full calendar grid. Omit phone status/home bars, Google Calendar branding/footer, menu/search/calendar toolbar icons, floating add button, and all other screen chrome or controls. Keep every date and tag inside the exact 390×588 crop and legible at normal viewing size. Output only the calendar crop.
reviewNotes: Raw ImageGen candidate, 1021x1540, visually inspected against the original crop and approved Japanese layout mock. Exact six-week calendar, Japanese labels and stacking, source-selected May 25; pure-white appearance, slate arrows, and coherent forest-green event tags follow current DESIGN.md. No post-processing. Status reviewed records visual inspection only; no owner approval or native implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
